source: Actual retained 53-series GDS summary catalogue, SHA256 932cae6c1baeaf8c2884b0ef8d4395017f00909f7da1df2977e9026b0e658c75. Catalogue search is not source evaluation.
question: Does a genuinely native EMC primary study identify donor/model, perturbation or serial condition, control/time and an orthogonal measured endpoint that supports one useful unanswered contrast beyond already-published assay results?
decision_changed: Only a source-authenticated, controlled and clinically or biologically useful unanswered contrast would justify a separately frozen numerical stage reviewed by lead. Otherwise preserve scoped inconclusive/no-go and every unresolved eligibility gap.
selection_before_titles: Inspect all 53 retained title/taxon/assay/count metadata fields. Rank exact native EMC/historical disease/model identities first, then genuinely ambiguous broader source designs with perturbation/time/orthogonal assays; select at most two actual new primary method/citation links distinct from owner after coordination. No favorable-result selection.
fields_allowed: Accession, title, disease/model labels, taxon, assay, sample count, citation/primary URLs, original methods/design and all named condition/control identifiers. No outcome, gene or biochemical values.
eligibility: Source-specific native human EMC donor/model identity, molecular/pathology limits, all EMC conditions, perturbation/time/control linkage, measured orthogonal assay, donor vs technical repeats, site/treatment/batch/model provenance. Engineered 293 or disputed/generic models cannot substitute.
strongest_alternatives: Non-EMC models in broad sarcoma/reference-contaminated catalogue
Generic recovery/preparation term mistaken for dynamic experimental design
Unpaired conditions or technical repeats mistaken for independent EMC donors
Published assay result or model adaptation mistaken for new disease biology
RNA changes without orthogonal functional measurement or useful comparison
disproof_stop: No authentic native EMC controlled conditions or useful unanswered contrast; inaccessible/uninspected linked evidence remains pending/unavailable by demonstrated route rather than biological negativity. No inventory or failed-hypothesis paper.
reuse_exclusions: GSE98824 all 30 WHIM conditions are source-authenticated triple-negative breast PDX, not EMC. Reuse verified R1–R9; no new static RNA panel, clocks, IR, APA, chemokine, 13-case proliferation, washout rescue or portal repeats.
restrictions: Denied FAP-tissue/glycan/structural-genomics/HLA/private-login/bypass remain closed. Quiet metadata/method source work only, no spend/GPU/outreach/PR/shared-root changes or push. Full catalogue/source originals ignored; compact evaluated records exported.
